cmake_language(CALL target_compile_options helios_u PRIVATE -mavx2)
cmake_language(EVAL CODE "target_compile_options(helios_u PRIVATE -mavx2)")
separate_arguments(_u_opts UNIX_COMMAND "-mavx2 -mfma")
target_compile_options(helios_u PRIVATE ${_u_opts})
set(_v -mavx2)
set(_n _v)
target_compile_options(helios_u PRIVATE ${${_n}})
external_helper(helios_u -mavx2)
message(STATUS "a message may name -mavx2")
if(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS MATCHES "-mavx2")
endif()
